subject.title: [Bug]: 6.x state migration leaves channel conversation-store SQLite empty (0 bytes) — orphans references, breaks proactive (Bot Framework) sends (MS Teams)

question: Should maintainers land the linked MS Teams migration guard now, or require broader recovery or packaged-upgrade proof first?
rationale: The issue is paired with a focused fix PR, but persisted-state migration archive behavior is upgrade-sensitive and should be accepted by an owner before the issue closes.

options.title: Land The Linked Guard
options.body: Accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98862 as the immediate fix for non-empty legacy sources that produce no visible conversation rows.

options.title: Require Upgrade Transcript
options.body: Ask for a redacted packaged upgrade or doctor transcript before accepting the migration behavior change.

options.title: Broaden Recovery First
options.body: Hold the fix path until it also addresses already archived sources or partial-import recovery.

recommendation.title: Land The Linked Guard
recommendation.body: Accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98862 as the immediate fix for non-empty legacy sources that produce no visible conversation rows.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the MS Teams SQLite conversation store and doctor migration boundary involved in this decision.
